_note: Plain-English steps for each top-200 sign, written for the printable cards. 'Main hand' = your dominant hand (right if right-handed). Standard citation forms; ASL Citizen signers sometimes use a variant, so the QR video is the reference.
YOU: Point it at the person you're talking to
W.H.A.T: Both hands open, palms up, in front of you
Shake them slightly side to side, with a questioning face (eyebrows down)
WHY: Touch your fingertips to your forehead
Pull the hand away and change it to a Y shape (thumb + pinky out)
WHERE: Point your index finger up, palm facing out
Wag it side to side a few times
HELP: Make a fist with your main hand, thumb up (A shape)
Rest it on the flat palm of your other hand
FINISH: Both hands open, fingers spread, palms facing you, at chest height
Flip them out quickly so the palms face down and away
ME: Point your index finger at your own chest
THANK-YOU: Touch your fingertips to your chin
Move the hand forward and down, toward the person
WHO: Make an L shape and touch your thumb to your chin
Wiggle the index finger, with a questioning face
PLEASE: Flat hand on the middle of your chest
HOW: Both hands bent, knuckles touching, backs of the fingers facing out
Roll them forward and up so the palms face up
DEAF: Touch near your ear, then near the corner of your mouth
NICE: Flat main hand on the flat palm of your other hand
Slide it forward across the palm
SORRY: Rub it in a circle on your chest
NOT: Fist with your thumb up (A shape)
Put the thumb under your chin and flick it forward
HELLO: Touch the side of your forehead (like a salute)
FINE: Tap your thumb on the middle of your chest
UNDERSTAND: Hold a fist next to your forehead, index finger tucked
NIGHT: Other arm flat across your body
Bent main hand, palm down, goes over the other wrist, like the sun setting
NAME: Both hands: index and middle fingers together (H shape)
Tap the main fingers across the other fingers twice, forming an X
SIGN: Circle them alternately toward your body, like pedaling
YES: Nod it up and down at the wrist, like a head nodding
KNOW: Tap your fingertips on the side of your forehead
OK: Spell O, then K: round O shape
Then index + middle up with thumb between them (K)
NO: Index and middle fingers out, thumb underneath
Snap the two fingers down onto the thumb, like a mouth closing
WRONG: Tap the middle knuckles on your chin
RIGHT: Bring the main hand down onto the other hand, side by side
WAIT: Both hands open, palms up, one in front of the other, off to the side
TODAY: Both Y hands (or flat hands), palms up, at the waist
Bounce them down slightly, together (= NOW + DAY)
WHICH: Move them up and down alternately, like weighing choices
TOMORROW: Thumb up (A shape) touching your cheek near the ear
Move it forward, arcing away from the face
WANT: Both hands open, palms up, fingers bent like claws
MORNING: Other arm across your body, hand in the crook of your main elbow
Flat main hand, palm up, rises up, like the sun
MONTH: Main index finger slides down along the back of it
WEEK: Main index finger slides across the palm, from heel to fingertips
GOAHEAD: Both flat hands, palms facing you
Push them forward and out, like inviting someone to go
BYE: Wave, or fold the fingers down and up
MAYBE: Move them up and down alternately, like a scale
GO: Flip them forward so they point away from you
CAN: Both fists (S shape) in front of you
TIME: Tap the back of your other wrist, where a watch would be
NUMBERS: Both hands: fingertips pinched together (flat O shape)
Touch the tips, twist the hands, and touch again
MORE: Both hands: fingertips pinched together (flat O shape)
Tap the fingertips of both hands together twice
WORK: Tap the main wrist on the back of the other wrist twice
PHONE: Hold it to your ear like a phone
HOME: Touch the corner of your mouth, then your cheek near the ear
SHOP: Main hand pinched (flat O) brushes out of the palm and forward twice
SOON: Tap them on your chin, or brush the fingertips on your chin
GET: Both hands open, in front of you
Pull them in toward you while closing them into fists, main fist on top
ONE: Index finger up, palm facing you
SEE: Index + middle fingers in a V, like eyes
Start at your eyes and move forward
THREE: Thumb, index and middle fingers up, palm facing you
YESTERDAY: Y shape or thumb up (A shape) at the corner of your chin / cheek
Move it back toward your ear
ELEVEN: Index finger held by the thumb, palm facing you
Flick the index finger up twice
AFTERNOON: Other arm flat across your body
Main forearm rests on it, tilted forward at an angle, flat hand palm down
CHANGE: Both hands: X shape (index finger hooked), knuckles touching
Twist them around each other so they swap places
BETTER: Move it out to the side and close into a thumb-up fist (A shape)
READY: Both R hands (index and middle crossed), pointing forward
Move them across in front of you, side to side
STOP: Chop the side of your main flat hand down onto it
YEAR: Both fists (S shape), main fist on top
Circle the main fist around the other one and land on top
FAMILY: Both F hands (thumb + index touch, other fingers up) touching
Circle them out and around until the pinkies touch
TIRED: Both bent hands, fingertips on your chest
Let them roll down / droop, with a tired face
TELL: Move it forward, away from you
GIVE: Both hands pinched (flat O / X shape), palms up
Move them forward toward the person, opening slightly
NEED: Hooked index finger (X shape), palm down
Bend the wrist down sharply once or twice
THINK: Touch the side of your forehead
HAPPY: Brush up and forward in small circles, with a happy face
RESTAURANT: Touch one side of your mouth, then the other
POLICEMAN: Tap it on the left side of your chest, like a badge
SLOW: Slowly slide your main hand from its fingertips up toward the wrist
WATER: Tap your index finger on your chin twice
REMEMBER: Move it down and press the thumb onto the other thumb (both A hands)
MOTHER: Tap your thumb on your chin
SLEEP: Open hand in front of your face
Pull it down and close the fingers, as your eyes close
LATER: L shape, thumb on your other flat palm
Tip the index finger forward, like a clock hand moving
DAY: Other arm flat across your body
Main index finger up, elbow on the other hand; arc it down to the other elbow
FATHER: Tap your thumb on your forehead
DRINK: C shape like holding a cup
MY: Press the palm on your chest
HOT: Claw hand in front of your mouth
Twist it away quickly, like spitting out something hot
LIKE: Open hand on your chest, thumb and middle finger apart
Pull it away while closing thumb and middle finger together
CALL: Hold it at your ear, then move it outward / toward the person
EAT: Tap them on your mouth twice
HURT: Both index fingers pointing at each other
Twist / jab them toward each other at the place that hurts
BATHROOM: T shape (thumb between index and middle fingers)
CAR: Both fists like holding a steering wheel
Move them like turning the wheel
LOVE: Both fists crossed over your chest, like a hug
BAD: Flat hand, fingertips at your chin
Flip it down so the palm faces down
HE: Point to the side, at the man you mean (or to where you put him)
SCHOOL: Both flat hands, main hand on top
Clap the main hand down on the other palm twice
EARLY: Main middle finger bent; slide it across the back of the other hand
LAST: Main pinky strikes down past it
LATE: Main hand flat, pointing down by your side
Bend it back and forth at the wrist
NEXT: Both bent hands, one in front of the other
Lift the back hand over the front one
DOG: Snap your fingers, like calling a dog
MILK: Fist (S shape) in front of you
Squeeze and open it, like milking
WILL: Flat hand by your cheek, palm facing the side
Move it forward, into the future
BOY: Fingers and thumb together near your forehead
Close them a few times, like gripping a cap brim
HEARING: Index finger in front of your mouth
Roll it forward in small circles
DRIVE: Both fists like holding a steering wheel
WASH: Both fists (A shape), main hand on top
Rub the main fist in circles on the other
HERE: Both flat hands, palms up, in front of you
Circle them outward on each side
SOME: Side of the main bent hand cuts across it and pulls back
MAKE: Both fists, main hand on top
Twist them in opposite directions, then tap
DIFFERENT: Both index fingers crossed in front of you
Pull them apart, out to the sides
THAT: Y shape (thumb + pinky out), palm down
Tap it down onto your other flat palm
BROTHER: L shape at your forehead (thumb touches)
Bring it down onto the other L hand
MEET: Both index fingers up, palms facing each other, apart
Bring them together until they touch
ZERO: Make an O shape with all fingers
SIX: Touch your thumb to your pinky, other three fingers up
SEVEN: Touch your thumb to your ring finger, other fingers up
EIGHT: Touch your thumb to your middle finger, other fingers up
NINE: Touch your thumb to your index finger (like OK), other fingers up
DATE: Main D hand (index up, others touch thumb) taps or circles it
READ: Other hand flat, palm up, like a page
V fingers (main hand) point at it and move down the page
NOTHING: Fingertips pinched together (O shape) under your chin
Push them forward and open the hand
LEARN: Main hand grabs from the palm and moves to your forehead, closing (flat O)
EXCUSE: Main fingertips brush across it forward, twice
BRING: Both flat hands, palms up, out to the side
Move them toward you (or toward where the thing goes)
AGAIN: Main bent hand flips over and taps the fingertips into the palm
PEOPLE: Both P hands (index up, middle forward, thumb between)
Circle them alternately forward, like pedaling
PLAY: Shake them by twisting your wrists
ILOVEYOU: Thumb, index and pinky up; middle and ring fingers down
Hold it up, palm facing out
STAY: Y shape (thumb + pinky out), palm down
EMAIL: Main index finger slides through it, like a letter going into a slot
HARD: Tap the main hand down onto the back of the other
MAN: Move it down to your chest
BOOK: Open them like opening a book
MOST: Both fists (A shape) touching, main on the bottom
Brush the main fist up past the other, high
PLAN: Both flat hands, palms facing each other
Move them across in front of you, side to side
SIT: Other hand: index + middle fingers flat (H shape)
Main bent H fingers sit on them, like legs on a chair
TEACH: Both hands pinched (flat O) at your forehead
WRITE: Main hand like holding a pen; write across the palm
BUY: Main hand (flat O, like holding money) lifts from the palm and moves forward
CLOSE: Both flat hands, palms down, apart
Bring them together side by side, like closing a door
COLOR: Open hand, fingers spread, in front of your chin
LOOKFOR: C shape in front of your face
OTHER: Thumb-up fist (A shape), thumb pointing up
Flip the hand over so the thumb points to the side
LETMESEE: V fingers (like SEE) under your eye
Twist slightly or tap, with a curious face
FOLLOW: Both thumb-up fists, one behind the other
Move them forward together, the back one following
ABOUT: Main index finger circles around the other fingertips
MANY: Flick all the fingers open, twice
DODO: Both hands: C shapes, palms down
Tap the thumbs against the index fingers twice, with a questioning face
REST: Both flat hands crossed on your chest, palms in
DOOR: Both B hands (flat) side by side, palms out
Swing the main hand open and back, like a door
FRIDAY: F shape (thumb + index touch, other fingers up)
Circle it in front of your shoulder
BED: Flat hand under your tilted cheek, like a pillow
TECHNOLOGY: Tap the bottom edge with the main middle finger, twice
INTERNET: Both hands: middle fingers bent toward each other
Touch the middle fingertips and rotate the hands
PET: Stroke the back of it with your main flat hand
INTERPRETER: Both F hands (thumb + index touch), facing each other
Twist them back and forth, then both flat hands move down (person)
HUG: Cross your arms over your chest
THINKPONDER: Circle it, like thinking something over
DONTKNOW: Pull it away and flip the palm out
WALK: Move them forward alternately, like feet
DONTLIKE: Start like LIKE: thumb and middle finger closing at your chest
Flick them outward and away, palm down
WOMAN: Move it down to your chest
CITY: Both flat hands, fingertips touching like a roof
Tap them together several times while moving to the side
POINTINDEX: Point at the thing you mean
GAS: Main thumb points down into it, like a gas pump nozzle
COOK: Main flat hand flips over on it, like flipping a pancake
TEACHER: Then both flat hands slide down your sides (person)
DOESNTMATTER: Both open hands, palms in, fingertips facing
Brush the fingertips past each other back and forth
YAY: Both hands up by your head, palms out
Shake / wave them (Deaf applause), happy face
COOL: Open hand, thumb on your chest
BREAKFAST: Then MORNING (flat hand rises from the crook of the other elbow)
WE: Index finger touches one side of your chest
Arc it over to the other side
EXCITED: Both middle fingers bent toward your chest
Brush up your chest alternately in circles
DONTWANT: Start like WANT: claw hands, palms up
Flip them over so the palms face down, out and away
TABLE: Both forearms flat, one on top of the other
Pat the top arm down on the bottom one
FUN: Index + middle fingers (H shape) touch your nose
Bring them down onto the other H fingers
EXPLANATION: Both F hands (thumb + index touch), palms facing
Move them forward and back alternately
THERE: Point at the place you mean
SUPPORT: Main fist pushes up under it
LONG: Run the main index finger up along it, from wrist to shoulder
TOOTHBRUSH-CA: Index finger sideways in front of your teeth
Move it back and forth, like brushing
EVERYDAY: Thumb-up fist (A shape) at your cheek
Brush it forward along the jaw, several times (TOMORROW repeated)
CHEAP: Other hand flat, palm facing you
Main flat hand brushes down across it
BELIEVE: Bring it down and clasp both hands together
IF: F shape (thumb + index touch, other fingers up)
Hold it out, then move it slightly or alternate both F hands
CALENDAR: Main C hand moves up and over it, like flipping a page
LISTEN: Cupped hand or index finger at your ear
Tap the ear, or hold it there, listening
MONDAY: Circle it in front of your shoulder
TUESDAY: T shape (thumb between index and middle)
Circle it in front of your shoulder
WEDNESDAY: Circle it in front of your shoulder
THURSDAY: H shape (index + middle together), or T then H
Circle it in front of your shoulder
SATURDAY: Circle it in front of your shoulder
SUNDAY: Both flat hands, palms out, in front of you
Circle them outward in small circles
DOCTOR: Tap the inside of the wrist with your main fingertips (or D / M hand), like taking a pulse
APPOINTMENT: Circle the main A hand above it, then press down on top
CANCEL: Draw an X across your other flat palm
PAY: Main index finger touches the palm, then flicks forward
HOSPITAL: Draw a cross on your upper arm
MEDICINE: Main middle finger bent; rub it in a small circle on the palm
SICK: Main one touches your forehead, the other touches your stomach
